_comment: Curated MCP catalog for Axocoatl. Reviewed 2026-08-23 against the maintainers' repositories and the npm/PyPI registries. A recommended badge identifies a current vendor-maintained integration, not a security certification. Servers from modelcontextprotocol/servers are educational reference implementations, not production recommendations. Stdio package specs are pinned to exact published versions; npx or uvx may download and cache that exact artifact on first connect. Hosted remote services are deployed independently and may change without a catalog revision. Bump version after changing an entry or package pin. args_template and env_template use {{PLACEHOLDER}} markers; the install modal substitutes collected values before adding the server to the running mcp_servers list.

servers.name: Brave Search
servers.description: Brave's vendor-maintained MCP server for web, image, video, news, place, and LLM-context search. Requires Node.js 22+, npx, and a Brave Search API plan. Axocoatl runs the exact npm release 2.1.3 over stdio.

requires.label: Brave Search API key
requires.help: Create a key in the Brave Search API developer dashboard. Usage and charges follow your Brave plan.

servers.name: GitHub (read-only remote)
servers.description: GitHub's hosted MCP server with its default toolsets restricted to read-only operations. A personal access token determines which repositories and data are visible; grant only the minimum access needed. GitHub deploys this remote service independently of the catalog.

requires.label: GitHub personal access token
requires.help: Use a fine-grained token when possible and limit it to the required repositories and read permissions. Availability is subject to GitHub account and organization policies.

servers.name: MCP reference: Documentation
servers.description: Official hosted server for searching and reading the public MCP documentation. Educational/reference use only. It also exposes a submit_feedback tool that sends documentation feedback to the MCP docs team, and the hosted tool surface may change independently of this catalog.

servers.name: MCP reference: Everything
servers.description: Educational test server that exercises MCP tools, prompts, resources, sampling, elicitation, and other protocol features. It is not a useful or production-ready service, and some demonstrations require client capabilities that Axocoatl may not provide. Exact npm release: 2026.8.18.

servers.name: MCP reference: Fetch
servers.description: Educational reference server that fetches URLs and converts HTML to markdown. It can reach local or internal addresses, so it is not a production-safe browsing boundary. Requires uvx and Python 3.10 or newer. Exact PyPI release: 2026.8.18.

servers.name: MCP reference: Filesystem
servers.description: Educational reference server for reading, writing, moving, searching, and deleting files under an explicitly allowed directory. The allowlist limits paths but does not make destructive tools harmless. Requires npx. Exact npm release: 2026.7.10.

servers.name: MCP reference: Git
servers.description: Educational reference server for inspecting and manipulating one local Git repository. Its tools can stage files, commit, reset the index, create branches, and switch branches; use it only where those writes are acceptable. Requires uvx and Python 3.10 or newer. Exact PyPI release: 2026.8.18.

servers.name: MCP reference: Memory
servers.description: Educational reference server that reads and mutates a local JSONL knowledge graph. It is a basic example rather than a production durability layer; keep backups if the data matters. Requires npx. Exact npm release: 2026.7.4.

requires.label: Memory JSONL file
requires.help: Choose a persistent location outside temporary package caches. The server creates or updates this file.

servers.name: MCP reference: Sequential Thinking
servers.description: Educational reference tool for a model-managed structured scratchpad. Scratchpad content is not hidden reasoning and may appear in tool records; stderr thought logging is disabled here. Requires npx. Exact npm release: 2026.7.4.

servers.name: MCP reference: Time
servers.description: Educational reference server for current-time queries and IANA timezone conversion, not a production recommendation. Requires uvx and Python 3.10 or newer. Exact PyPI release: 2026.8.18.
